propositions: The rebar-brainstorm skill documentation lacks explicit guidance that a blocked/not-yet-claimable ticket has completed the review cycle successfully and requires no further agent action until its blockers resolve
Agents are rationalizing repeated use of rebar review-plan --force on blocked tickets from vague human instructions, defeating the plan-review gate's claimability fast-fail mechanism

The skill documentation must prohibit review-plan --force as an agent move and clarify it is a human-operator-only escape hatch, with guidance to ask a clarifying question instead of inferring authorization
A forced review on blocked tickets produces a signed attestation against non-final dependencies that silently goes stale, creating false confidence in the review verdict
